scope: All ten full-frame contact-sheet views, annotation-overlay presentation and retained demonstration background
engineering_observations: All ten tiles are full frames, with readable GSD/presence captions and gold rectangle overlays only on the five target-present views.

This is the predeclared descent snapshot at t=8 s with original GAMA root depth 1.9 m. The positive row shows a dark tapered silhouette inside the direct amodal rectangles, with fewer body details as GSD increases.
The owned-target silhouette and its gold rectangle are absent from the negative row. Other demonstration animals remain unlabelled background and occupy corresponding locations in the pairs.

Some background animal brightness or texture detail differs between positive and negative rows, especially the large animal entering from the upper edge. These frames are not claimed to be pixel-identical pairs.

The behavioural label is metadata for a static upright mesh proxy. This view did not demonstrate biologically certified descent pose, body animation, breathing, water optics or exact visible/refracted outlines.
